properties.management: Maintain upland gallery forest buffers and contour soil-conservation practices along headwater tributaries.
properties.summary: Upper Ogun mainstem and headwaters upstream of the Oyan confluence (HydroBASINS L9 upstream tracing). Basement-complex terrain where shallow soils and steeper slopes generate seasonal infiltration-excess overland flow.

properties.management: Integrate telemetric stage monitoring with reservoir operating records where gauge data are available.
properties.summary: Oyan and Ofiki tributary basin upstream of the Oyan Dam outlet, regulated by the Oyan Reservoir.

properties.management: Preserve non-buildable fluvial setback corridors and monitor bank stability along braided mainstem reaches.
properties.summary: Mainstem reach from the Oyan confluence past Abeokuta to about 6.9 N, across the basement-to-sedimentary transition.

properties.management: Restrict wetland reclamation in low-lying alluvial floodplains to preserve natural flood storage capacity.
properties.summary: Lowest Ogun reaches and side tributaries between about 6.9 N and the Lagos Lagoon, a low-gradient alluvial floodplain prone to seasonal ponding.

properties.management: Combine satellite NDTI plume monitoring with in-situ gravimetric TSS sampling and coastal wetland conservation.
properties.summary: Downstream estuarine receiving environment where the Ogun River discharges into the northwest Lagos Lagoon. Evaluated specifically for open-water spectral turbidity (NDTI).
